authored.scope: Authored numerical comparisons of re-equilibrated normal-pad quadrature at fixed floor mesh, physical geometry, normal compliance, loads and unilateral law. Both compared states must meet their own exact clipped-affine force/centroid screen. If16to32 fails, execute64 and apply unchanged criteria32to64. This is neither an asymptotic error bound nor physical contact, material, concrete-head, reinforcement, corner-stress or whole-house acceptance.
